title: TXT chapter parser over-matches body text that looks like a chapter title
symptom: Sentences such as `第一章正文。` were interpreted as chapter headings, which produced incorrect TOC boundaries and could leave later chapter bodies empty or shifted.
root_cause: The chapter-heading regex was too permissive. It matched body sentences that started with chapter-like numerals even when they were not standalone headings.
fix: Tightened chapter-title patterns so only realistic heading shapes are treated as chapter starts.
Added parser and import regression tests that cover正文首句-like cases and normal `第X章` headings.
impact: Incorrect chapter boundaries break both TOC navigation and any later reading-position logic that depends on chapter offsets.
